Miqaat is a prayer clock. It calculates the five daily prayer times on this device for the place you choose, plays the azaan, and can count down to iqamah for prayer at home.  Nothing is uploaded: there is no account, no advertising and no analytics. Two things use the network — the optional place-name lookup (Android's geocoder, run by Google) and the update check on GitHub in the direct-download edition. Both are off until you use them.
Setup takes about a minute: your place → check the times → azaan alerts.

قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: عَجَبًا لأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ، إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ، وَلَيْسَ ذَاكَ لأَحَدٍ إِلاَّ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ، إِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ سَرَّاءُ شَكَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ، وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ ضَرَّاءُ صَبَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for all of it is good, and that is for no one but the believer: if ease comes to him he is grateful, and that is good for him; and if hardship comes to him he is patient, and that is good for him.”
Narrated by Ṣuhayb ar-Rūmī  ·  Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2999
